publisher_policy.name: Rockstar Games: Policy on posting copyrighted Rockstar Games material
publisher_policy.summary_for_review: Allows occasional, NON-COMMERCIAL fan use. Monetized use is outside the policy's stated scope. Spoilers (endings, cutscene compilations, big reveals), isolated cinematics, in-game TV/comedy in isolation and pre-release footage are removed. Re-check before every publication; the policy can change.

2D.label: 2D universe
2D.note: The top-down era. Shares city NAMES with later universes but is a separate continuity.

3D.label: 3D universe
3D.note: Its Vice City is a 1980s-set city; separate continuity from the 2D and HD universes.

HD.label: HD universe
HD.note: Its cities are reimaginings, not the same places as their 2D or 3D namesakes. Events and characters do not carry across universes unless a source explicitly says so.
